Twenty-seven canonical candidates have source-specific stimulus, neural-response, behavior and pain-boundary extraction. S776 distinguishes heat behavior from vibration calcium imaging; S777 has expression/GRASP evidence without a measured stimulus-evoked neural response; S778 gives peripheral nerve firing and rolling. S797 separates MD IV thermogenetic activation, chordotonal vibration, GCaMP signals, larval escape, EM anatomy and a simple steady-state rate model. Backward and forward citation screening remains open; no subjective-pain or human SCS inference follows. Two candidates, S794-S795, were independently reconciled from saved primary leads; both have relevant larval nociception behavior, neither has direct stimulus-evoked neural response. S797 was independently reconciled from the S282 v1 bibliography. S212/S282 citation relationship for S794-S795 remains unverified; count 27 is not an itemized inventory. Five independently checked bibliography leads and their scope/status are itemized in drosophila-nociception-audit.json, but they are only a partial screen and do not reconcile the aggregate 27. S282 v1 pp. 38 and 32 were checked against Pulver (2009; PMCID PMC2694103) and Ainsley et al. (2003; PMID 12956960). Pulver abstract and indexed figure legends indicate a neuronal activation/tool comparator without a direct noxious-stimulus assay; methods-level screen remains pending because the linked PMC author manuscript returned reCAPTCHA. Ainsley full publisher VoR PDF was checked via a Wayback capture: it reports spontaneous crawling, no direct neural recording, and a hot-probe comparison marked data not shown; S282 v1 p. 24 cites it as ppk-driver provenance in Methods/Fly Stocks, not as nociception evidence. S801 is a separate 2013 natural-wasp-attack study (PLOS DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0078704), published from S777 reference #9 after primary full-text review; class-IV perturbation and larval rolling are behavior evidence without direct neural recording. S802 (Pan et al. 2023, DOI 10.1016/j.cub.2023.02.032) was published from S769 References #46 after primary full-text review; it separates heat, gentle touch, C4da activation, A08n spikelets, Cho calcium signals, rolling and crawling. NS-03 now has 26 canonical candidates with four-field extraction. The independent 28-work bibliography has 11 exact DOI matches and 17 DOI-unmatched screened leads; one additional lead, Honjo and Tracey (2018; 10.1371/journal.pgen.1007464), has been selected for canonical-card review after independent full-text triage; it remains DOI-unmatched and is not yet a canonical source. The historical aggregate 27 remains unreconciled.

search_streams.coverage_note: EVOKE 3/12-month Lancet (S779), 24-month JAMA (S780) and 36-month RAPM (S781) reports are indexed as one randomized cohort, NCT02924129. The separate JAMA Figure 4C correction is S805, not a fourth trial report. The separate Springer method-label correction to S162 is S806 and supplies no replacement outcomes. The Lancet method is abstract-only here; JAMA full text distinguishes 134 randomized primary-outcome records from 92 24-month completers. The 36-month analysis was not prespecified and used LOCF. ECAP is feedback for the intervention, not a pain measure or baseline outcome predictor. Broader snowballing remains open.
